facts_found: Credit card applications are completed by the customer online: provide personal information and income details, consent to a credit check, submit requested documentation, review the preliminary offer/terms, and accept the terms to finalize account setup. [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_001]

Bronze application steps require the customer to gather government ID, SSN/TIN, income and housing details, submit the application online, consent to a credit pull, review the offer, and confirm disclosures and e-sign to open the account. [doc_credit_cards_bronze_rewards_card_001]

Gold application requires the customer to complete the application in their Rho-Bank dashboard and consent to a credit pull; the customer submits and monitors status themselves. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

No agent-facing tool for submitting a credit card application appears in the KB; agent tools cover statement credits, downgrades, and credit-limit increases, not new-card applications. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008]

Some promotional offers are claimed by the customer via self-service: open the account portal, navigate to promotional offers, select the offer, and confirm acceptance within the claim window; an on-screen or email confirmation indicates the offer is active. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_013]

Promotional eligibility commonly requires the account to be open and in good standing and the claim to occur within a defined eligible window; claims after the end date are not eligible for activation. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_013]

New-customer fee-waiver and 0% APR promos are restricted to new customers who open an account within the promotional window, and the account must remain open and in good standing to retain the benefit. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_011]
Silver Rewards 0% APR first-year promo requires applications and account openings within the offer window (2025-10-15 to 2025-12-31). [doc_credit_cards_silver_rewards_card_009]

Platinum Rewards first-year fee waiver requires submitting the application within the promo window and being approved; the waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the window. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009]
Diamond Elite membership is invitation-only and invitations are time-limited, so the recipient must respond promptly to redeem the invitation offer. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_001]

Diamond Elite invitation promo requires meeting a spending requirement ($50,000 within the specified promo period) to waive the annual fee and earn the statement credit. [doc_credit_cards_diamond_elite_card_006]
Card eligibility is gated by minimum credit-score thresholds (e.g., Bronze $640, Silver $680, Gold $720 with Rho-Bank+ subscription required). [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

The KB does not explicitly state that an agent is prohibited from submitting a credit card application; it only shows that applications are customer-completed self-service online flows and no agent application tool exists.

No documented promotional restrictions specific to mailed offers (e.g., one-per-household, non-transferable, expiration tied to the mailer) beyond general new-customer/window/good-standing rules.

The KB defines a transfer reason code 'customer_demands_after_unavailable_offer_refusal' for cases where the customer asked about offers/promotions that do not exist in the system, was informed the offers are unavailable, persisted multiple times, and now demands a human. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]

facts_found: Gold Rewards Card key terms list Annual fee: $0.00 (plus minimum credit score 720 and required Rho-Bank+ premium subscription), so there is no first-year annual fee to waive. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

The Gold Rewards Card application doc describes no new-customer promotional offer, promo window, or fee-waiver campaign; it directs the customer to complete the application in the Rho-Bank dashboard and monitor status. [doc_credit_cards_gold_rewards_card_001]

Repeated KB searches for a Gold Rewards Card first-year annual fee waiver / promo offer return no Gold Rewards Card promotion document; documented first-year fee waivers exist only for Platinum Rewards, Business Platinum Rewards, Business Silver Rewards, and the Diamond Elite invitation offer. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009]

Platinum Rewards first-year fee waiver requires submitting the application within the promo window (2024-06-01 to 2024-12-31) and being approved; the waiver cannot be retroactively applied to accounts opened outside the window. [doc_credit_cards_platinum_rewards_card_009]

Business Platinum Rewards first-year fee waiver is reflected on the account automatically during the first year of membership provided the account is opened within the promotion dates (2025-11-01 to 2026-02-28); it is not something an agent attaches. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_platinum_rewards_card_011]

Business Silver Rewards first-year fee waiver requires opening the account within the promotional window (2025-11-15 to 2026-01-15); if the first statement does not show 0, support reviews the account for promotional eligibility. [doc_business_credit_cards_business_silver_rewards_card_011]

The agent annual-fee-waiver tool apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 is documented only inside the Credit Card Retention Protocol, for customers with 2+ years of tenure who are trying to close over annual-fee concerns, using reason 'loyalty_benefit'. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

apply_credit_card_account_flag_6147 requires credit_card_account_id and user_id as required arguments, so it can only act on an existing card account, not a pending application. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_003]

The agent statement-credit tool apply_statement_credit_8472 requires user_id, credit_card_account_id, amount, and reason; the credit_card_account_id is obtained via get_credit_card_accounts_by_user, which returns only active and closed credit card accounts (not pending applications). [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

apply_statement_credit_8472 supports reason 'promotional_credit' (credit from a promotional offer or campaign) and 'annual_fee_reversal' (reversal of an annual fee charge), but both operate on an existing account after it exists. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_017]

Agent tools documented for credit cards cover statement credits, retention annual-fee flags, downgrades, closures, and credit-limit increases; no agent tool exists for submitting or modifying a new credit card application. [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_account_logistics_008]
For a pending application status, the documented guidance is to await the application decision; no manual intervention is needed or available. [doc_credit_cards_credit_cards_(general)_001]

Promotional offer claiming in the KB is a customer self-service flow in the account portal (navigate to promotional offers, select, confirm within the claim window) and requires the account to be open and in good standing — i.e., it cannot be done before the account exists. [doc_business_credit_cards_silver_zoom_card_013]

The KB defines transfer reason code 'unconfirmed_external_communication' for when a customer claims a promotion exists based on a letter, email, or flyer that the agent cannot verify in the KB after searching. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
The KB provides no procedure for validating whether a mailed flyer or direct-mail communication is genuinely from Rho-Bank. [doc_bank_accounts_bank_accounts_(general)_042]
Gold Rewards Card is classified as a premium-tier card for replacement shipping purposes (complimentary expedited shipping). [doc_credit_cards_credit_card_replacements_002]

open_questions: No KB document lists ANY promotional offer for the Gold Rewards Card, so it cannot be confirmed whether an off-system/targeted Gold Rewards mailer campaign exists.
No documented procedure exists for validating the authenticity or terms of a mailed/direct-mail offer flyer, or for honoring mailer terms after an application has been submitted.

The KB does not explicitly state a prohibition on agents modifying pending applications; it only shows that no agent application-modification tool exists and that pending applications require no manual intervention.
No documented fallback path (e.g., supervisor or marketing-ops escalation) for honoring an unverifiable mailed promotional offer.
